method: Historical DDM work was read for FUNCTIONAL INTENT only. Byte shape and serial stage order are not treated as current ontology, per HQD-125 §2 and §15.

historical_version_markers.reading: The entire V551J/V553 temporal edifice is explicitly provisional and sparse. It is functional capital, never binding authority.

matrix.rationale: V553 temporal identity requires EXACTLY ONE explicit survey family per temporal track and refuses mixed families. The function — a track must declare which survey family it belongs to — is essential to F7 and is missing from the current DAG.
require_survey_identity per wave plus an explicit calendar anchor is the correct fail-closed function. A wave is not a time without a declared anchor.

_explicit_temporal_year is documented as resolving a real calendar anchor 'without treating a wave ordinal as a year'. This is a CONSTRAINT that must bind any F7 producer. The specific list of year-accepting column names is obsolete implementation detail.
Refuses duplicate anchors per year within a track. Sound; but the year-keyed form is tied to the point-year grain (see the time-grain fork in 12).

V553_WAVE_HARMONIZATION_AUTHORITY_INDEX_SCHEMA + V553_WAVE_HARMONIZATION_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA establish that cross-wave comparability requires an explicit authority artifact, not an inference. This is the F7 comparability precondition.
V553_HARMONIZATION_DIFFERENCE_LEDGER_SCHEMA records divergence between harmonized waves rather than reconciling it. Directly supports HARMONIZATION_DIFFERENCE != RECONCILED_TRUTH.

V553_TEMPORAL_KEY_CANDIDATE_INDEX_SCHEMA plus V553_TEMPORAL_KEY_BLOCKER_INDEX_SCHEMA is the single most important conserved concept: a temporal key is a CANDIDATE with a companion BLOCKER index. Blocks noncomparability in the same structure that proposes keys.
V551J-D cross-wave semantic diff compares two runs for meaning change. The function is required; the binary left/right topology is obsolete because F6+F7 needs N sources and multiple trajectories.

V551J carries directionality_status, directionality_basis and directionality_coverage_status as TYPED FIELDS. Directionality must be established with a basis and a coverage statement, never inferred from two waves existing. This is the exact functional form of HQD-125's TWO_WAVES_EXIST != TEMPORAL_DIRECTIONALITY_AUTHORITY.
V553_CROSS_WAVE_DELTA_INDEX_SCHEMA exists as a first-class contract. Delta as an indexed artifact distinct from the observations is the right shape.
direction is computed in V553 (44 mentions) and typed in V551J. Magnitude is not separately contracted; treat magnitude as requiring its own constitution.
V553_TEMPORAL_PRESSURE_FIELD_SCHEMA + V553_YEAR_INDEXED_PRESSURE_OVER_TIME_SCHEMA express the F7 product shape: a field tracked across an ordered time axis.

V553 computes rupture_pressure as max(0.0, pressure_intensity * 0.10) gated on status. A hard-coded scalar coefficient is a provisional artefact and must NOT be inherited as the definition of structural pressure.
V553_COUNTRY_YEAR_PRESSURE_FIELD_SCHEMA and the parquet/Arrow compiler topology are storage and execution choices, not ontology. HQD-125 §2 forbids inheriting serial stage topology.

V553_CONFIDENCE_PENALTY_LEDGER_SCHEMA + V553_PRESSURE_BASIS_LEDGER_SCHEMA make uncertainty a first-class ledger rather than an implicit discount. F7 needs this to distinguish a weak delta from no delta.
The ledger family makes the authority behind a temporal product inspectable and replayable.
V553_TEMPORAL_GAP_AND_ABSENCE_INDEX_SCHEMA is the correct home for ABSENCE as a first-class observation, supporting ABSENCE != ZERO and NONCOMPARABLE != NO_CHANGE.
Blocks are indexed beside candidates so a refused key is itself recorded. This is what makes fail-closed temporal identity auditable.
V553_STRUCTURAL_RUPTURE_CANDIDATE_INDEX_SCHEMA names a rupture CANDIDATE. Keeping the word CANDIDATE is the whole point: empirical discontinuity is not an authorized rupture classification.
V553_RUPTURE_BLOCK_AUDIT_SCHEMA. A rupture candidate must be able to BLOCK a relation rather than be silently absorbed.

V553_RUPTURE_EVENT_SLOT_LEDGER_SCHEMA exists but every row carries rupture_override_status = 'reserved_not_filled'. The slot was RESERVED and NEVER FILLED. Conserve the slot; bind nothing into it. No external-event authority was ever established.
V553_INTERPOLATION_POLICY_LEDGER_SCHEMA plus an explicit allow_interpolation boolean makes interpolation a policy decision that is recorded, not an implicit default.
interpolation_across_rupture_allowed is hard-coded False. Conserve the prohibition. Whether it survives as law is a current-authority question (see 08).
When interpolation is not allowed the historical method is 'gap_marked_unknown' and pressure_status 'interpolated' vs 'anchor' is explicit. Gaps default to typed unknown.
Linear interpolation is a provisional numerical choice. Do not inherit it. If interpolation is ever authorised the method must be separately constituted.
Copying an anchor value forward manufactures a fake observation. Must not be inherited as a default; ABSENCE != ZERO forbids silent substitution.

The string 'causal' occurs ZERO times across the 4187-line V553 temporal pressure module. There was never any causal machinery to inherit. Naming a cause for a temporal break requires NEW authority that does not exist in any class.
V553_FORBIDDEN_INFERENCE_AUDIT_SCHEMA and V553_FORBIDDEN_ACTOR_GENERATION_AUDIT_SCHEMA show the historical system actively audited for forbidden inference. The F8 firewall has an audit precedent.

V554 turns V553 pressure and harmonization evidence into bounded seed affordance ledgers plus a lawful V555 handoff index, and states 'It does not generate persona content.' That is the F8 contract function and the actor firewall in one sentence.
292 mentions of seed: the handoff consumes V553 temporal products as bounded affordances rather than regenerating them. Current F8 seam exists; the temporal input to it does not.
HQD-125 §2: the chain is a functional acceptance law, not a demand to recreate historical serial stage topology.
